description: OVERLAY.md and the front matter of any document. A case with an input ('text', 'base64', or 'parts', a list of [text, times] to concatenate) and optional 'limits' ('max_bytes', 'max_depth') expects the split and the reading: 'case' is 'none', 'malformed', 'unterminated', 'too-large', 'empty', 'unknown-format', 'does-not-parse', 'not-a-mapping' or 'mapping'; offsets are bytes from the start of the file and lines count from 1; 'metadata' and 'body' are text ('..._base64' when not UTF-8, '..._size' when the input is 'parts'); 'format' is the format read; 'data' is the manifest where there is one, and 'error' and 'line' what a gate refuses with ('line' only where one answer is right whatever the parser). A 'context_file' case expects the context's 'text', or an 'error'. A 'files' case gives an overlay's files by relative path (text, or {'base64': ...}) and expects 'manifest_file', 'manifest', the 'context' entries in order ('OVERLAY.md' standing for its body), 'context_ignored', 'issues' (pointers of the manifest's problems), 'applies', 'harness_context' where a harness names context, 'digest' where stated; or an 'error' and 'line'.
